div.div: ضَنْءٌ Children, or offspring; as also ↓ ضِنْءٌ ; (S, M, O, K; [and so ضَنْوٌ and ضِنْوٌ, as mentioned in art. ضنو;]) the former accord. to El-Umawee, and both accord. to AA: (S, O:) the former signifies the offspring of anything: (TA:) and also, (K, TA, [in a copy of the M ↓ the latter, but this is app. a mistranscription,]) multitude of offspring: it is like نَفَرٌ (M, K) and رَهْطٌ, (M,) having no. n. un.: the pl. is ضُنُوْءٌ. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
